correctness.rationale: Each pair whose unique tree path uses v gains (1-p)p^d on protection, including the (v,v) term. Avoiding v in W_T removes precisely the through-v terms and leaves n-1 diagonals and twice the distinct residual unordered sum, verifying the repair's exact ranking and tie equivalence. I reconstructed the classification using all-root canonicalization and leaf attachment instead of Prüfer words and generated both bond and site path counts by tracing unique paths. Each n-tree has a leaf deletion to an (n-1)-tree, so this exhausts the 1,1,1,2,3,6,11,23 shapes. The transformed integer difference (1+t)^7 Q(t/(1+t)) is nonnegative coefficientwise for a single common optimizer at 21 order-eight shapes. The remaining two have disjoint exact maximizer sets at 1/2 and 9/10. Recounted differences are 2p(1-p²-p³) and 2p(1-2p²); I checked a nonzero nonnegative transformed difference against each otherwise excluded competitor. The equal score vectors in the second witness and its polynomial sign give the entire tie sets, not just observations at two probabilities. The repair narrows attribution, preserves the correct witness lists and certificate, and needs no change to the frozen verifier.
